regions.finding: Two distinct scope experiments retained: 1k+2a→3ka (48%) and 1a+2g→3ag (67%, 94% purity), each under the displayed Rh/K2CO3/MeOH room-temperature 2 h conditions.
Four different directing-group substrates 6b–6e are separate failure/recovery experiments under standard conditions; quantitative/99%/56% recoveries and no-expected-product outcomes remain distinct.
TIPS allene-ene 2h gives 4ah (38%) and 5ah (16%) with the allene untouched; N-methoxybenzamide 6a gives 7aa in 10% isolated yield with 76% recovery after 96 h. These are separate experiments.

Three mechanistic experiments retained: no-2a CD3OD exchange with two recovery time points, 1a+2a cyclization in CD3OD (66%, no D incorporation), and the parallel 1a/1a-d5 KIE experiment (kH/kD=12.3).
Kinetic plot and prose report first-order dependence on 1a. Approximate plotted time extent is recorded as graph context, not a fabricated total reaction time.

unresolved: Several mechanistic arrows omit scale, atmosphere, workup, analytical basis, and detection limits.
Scheme 3a does not state the standard-condition duration used for each failed directing group.

regions.finding: Kinetic plot and prose report zero-order dependence on 2a; unprinted concentrations/sampling details remain missing.
Proposed carbonate-ligated Rh(III) catalytic cycle with Int1–Int5/Int3'; classified as mechanism, not isolated experiments or products.

Three distinct follow-up reactions retained: N-alkylation of 3aa to 9 (75%), NIS iododesilylation to 11 (78%), and TiCl4 desilylation to 10 (63%), with displayed equivalents, solvents, temperatures, and times.
